title: Klaim, Tuduhan, dan Bukti
author: Rahmat Wibowo, CEO Infraloka
description: Laporan kesadaran publik berjudul lengkap “Klaim, Tuduhan, dan Bukti”, dengan subjudul “Studi kasus Abil Sudarman dan ASSAI untuk literasi publik tentang verifikasi influencer, pendidikan digital, dan risiko salah menuduh”. Memuat ringkasan eksekutif, daftar barang bukti beserta penilaian keterbatasannya, pembahasan efek Dunning-Kruger, konteks hukum dan pemetaan pasal, rekomendasi tindakan, serta referensi.
note: Dokumen menyatakan dirinya bukan putusan, bukan tuduhan pidana, dan bukan nasihat hukum; kata “penipuan”, “gelar palsu”, “identitas palsu”, atau “penggunaan merek tanpa izin” tidak dipakainya sebagai kesimpulan fakta terhadap Abil Sudarman maupun ASSAI. Halamannya berupa gambar, sehingga teksnya tidak bisa dicari atau dibaca pembaca layar; deskripsi ini yang bisa dicari.

en.title: Claims, Allegations, and Evidence
en.description: A public-awareness report with the full title "Claims, Allegations, and Evidence", subtitled "A case study of Abil Sudarman and ASSAI for public literacy on verifying influencers, digital education, and the risk of false accusation". It contains an executive summary, a list of exhibits with an assessment of their limitations, a discussion of the Dunning-Kruger effect, legal context and mapping of provisions, recommended actions, and references.
en.note: The document states that it is not a ruling, not a criminal accusation and not legal advice; it does not use the words "fraud", "fake degree", "false identity" or "unauthorised use of a brand" as factual conclusions about Abil Sudarman or ASSAI. Its pages are images, so the text cannot be searched or read by screen readers; this description is what can be searched.
